title: Implement: TOON Format Integration - Token Optimization
description:
Build: Integrate TOON (Token-Oriented Object Notation) format into the agentic system to reduce LLM token consumption by 30-60%. This is macpro51's first production Builder task.

**Repository**: https://github.com/toon-format/toon

**Objectives**:
1. Build and test TOON on Linux (macpro51)
2. Verify cross-platform compatibility
3. Benchmark token savings vs current JSON serialization
4. Identify integration points in our system:
   - Enhanced memory entity serialization
   - Task queue definitions
   - Cluster state synchronization
   - Agent-to-agent communication

**Success Criteria**:
- TOON builds successfully on Fedora Linux
- All tests pass
- Token savings quantified with real examples
- Integration recommendations documented
- Production-ready implementation plan

**Node Assignment**: macpro51 (Builder, Linux native)
